name: lost_delivered_package_support_escalation
use_case: Support case escalation and service error recovery
branch: Customer reports package not received although tracking indicates delivered 3 days ago
tests: the agent verifies ownership, checks tracking, and opens a support case for missing/lost delivery investigation
instruction:
You ordered items under order O420. The carrier tracking says delivered 3 days ago, but you never received the package and it is nowhere near your door. You want support to investigate and open a case for you.

Your details:
Name: Liam Evans
Email: liam.evans@example.com
Postal code: 94102
Order ID: O420

persona.name: Liam Evans
persona.initial_message: Hi, my order O420 shows as delivered 3 days ago on tracking, but I never received it. Can you help open an investigation case?
